_note: Copy this file, replace every placeholder, and pass it with --flows. One flow = one user journey. Every page in the resulting graph is reached by tapping, never by intent, so the page set can serve as an FN denominator.

_steps.launch: force-stop then start the app's launcher activity (Android) or EntryAbility (OpenHarmony)
_steps.am_start: {"component": "<pkg/.Act>", "extras": {"<key>": "<value>"}} — only for flows that may use an intent
_steps.tap: tap the first node whose text/content-desc matches
_steps.expect_visible: any-of assertion on the visible texts after the step
_steps.expect_page_changed: the page fingerprint must differ from before the step
